sources.title: GLM-4.6 original release announcement
sources.evidence: Complete indexed original announcement is dated September 30, 2025 and explicitly releases GLM-4.6 for API, chat, coding agents and public weights. Direct page retrieval returned a client shell; indexed text supplied the full announcement. States 200K context, reasoning and tool use.

sources.title: GLM-4.6 exact checkpoint card
sources.evidence: MIT license metadata; exact GLM-4.6 card links its developer repository and native API. It states 200K context, reasoning and tool use. It links the earlier GLM-4.5 technical report explicitly as a GLM-4.5 report; no predecessor counting convention is silently transferred.

sources.title: Official model download table at pinned repository revision
sources.evidence: Exact GLM-4.6 BF16 row identifies model size 355B-A32B; a separate FP8 row has the same nominal figures. This directly reports this model, rather than inheriting sibling numbers. Raw pinned Markdown was retrieved. Table does not define a GLM-4.6 embedding/output/MTP counting boundary.

sources.title: GLM-4.6 exact model configuration
sources.evidence: Glm4MoeForCausalLM: 92 main decoder layers, first 3 dense, 160 routed experts with top 8 selected plus 1 shared, 1 next-token prediction layer, hidden size 5120 and QK normalization. Text-only configuration, untied embeddings and max_position_embeddings=202752.

sources.title: GLM-4.6 exact chat template
sources.evidence: Explicit tools/function serialization, tool-call and tool-response branches, reasoning_content and enable_thinking. Text-content rendering only. Confirms reasoning and structured function calling for the checkpoint.

sources.title: GLM-4.6 native API overview
sources.evidence: Exact native page specifies text input and output, 200K context, 128K maximum output, tool use and thinking controls. Complete page was accessed, including sample calls for glm-4.6.

sources.title: GLM-4.6 provider endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct JSON lists the exact Z.AI route with 202752 context and 131072 output, matching released checkpoint capacity. Novita advertises 204800 and Venice 198000; limits are route-specific. Model architecture metadata is text to text. No inference request was executed.

sources.title: Exact public checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Verified public ungated weight repository at revision be72194883d968d7923a07e2f61681ea9a2826d1. Automated safetensors tally mixes BF16 and F32 elements and was not treated as an exact learned-parameter count. No whole weight files downloaded.

sources.title: GLM-4.6 AI Gateway provider specifications
sources.evidence: Original provider page corroborates September 30 release and documents a 204.8K context route. This differs from the exact checkpoint and Z.AI endpoint limit; not used to replace those native specifications.

sources.title: Later GLM-4.7 comparison card
sources.evidence: Checked later official card for exact GLM-4.6 disclosure. It contains capability comparisons for the predecessor but no more precise GLM-4.6 parameter accounting. The exact later developer download table in s3 supplies the nominal figures.

name.note: Exact released text-model name; distinct from GLM-4.6V and provider quantization variants.

developer.note: Official Z.ai / zai-org publication; normalized zhipuai developer ID retained.

family.note: Member of the GLM model family.

release_date.note: Explicit original developer release date, corroborated by the provider. Repository creation is not used as release proof.

open_weights.note: Exact public ungated checkpoint and explicit original weight-release announcement.

license.note: License declared by the original model card for this exact checkpoint; no separate LICENSE file was listed. No broad terms for unrelated service code inferred.

parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal model size from the exact GLM-4.6 download row, not an exact complete tensor tally. The table does not specify the accounting boundary; the GLM-4.5 report excludes embeddings/output and includes MTP, but that convention is not asserted for GLM-4.6 without an explicit statement. No synthetic subtotal or mixed-dtype storage count used.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal author-reported active count for exact GLM-4.6; top-8 routing plus a shared expert is independently configured. This is not a recomputed per-step count, and MTP/embedding inclusion is not resolved by the download table.

architecture.note: Sparse decoder Transformer with grouped-query attention and QK normalization: 3 dense plus 89 MoE main layers, 160 routed experts/top 8 and 1 shared expert, plus a configured MTP layer. No architecture copied from a sibling.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint position limit and exact Z.AI route agree at 202752, advertised by native docs as 200K. Other routes can advertise 204800 (Novita/Vercel) or 198000 (Venice); 131072 maximum output is a separate constraint.

modalities.note: Native text input/output. GLM-4.6V visual capabilities and tool-rendered media are not transferred.

reasoning.note: Exact template and native API expose thinking on/off and reasoning content.

tool_call.note: Exact template serializes function definitions, structured calls and tool responses; original developer documents tool use during reasoning.

description.value: Text MoE model for reasoning, coding and tool use, with a 200K-token context window.
description.note: Replaces vague workhorse positioning with supported architecture and capabilities.

patch.description: Text MoE model for reasoning, coding and tool use, with a 200K-token context window.

sources.label: Official model download table at pinned repository revision

patch.notes: Z.ai reports nominal 355B total and 32B active for GLM-4.6 in its exact model download row. These are not exact tensor counts; the table does not resolve embedding, output-head or MTP inclusion, so the GLM-4.5 counting convention is not silently transferred. The released checkpoint and Z.AI provider route specify 202752 tokens, while some other routes advertise 204800; native documentation rounds this to 200K. Maximum output is a separate limit. This is the text-only GLM-4.6, not GLM-4.6V.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Adds MIT, nominal 355B total/32B active and directly configured MoE architecture. Corrects context to the 202752 native/checkpoint limit while preserving provider-specific 204800 in notes. Confirms September 30 release, text-only input/output, reasoning and tools. No unsupported sibling count scope or exact tensor total is asserted.
